APPROVE

The loop body moved into `MergeReportRows` and `AddBranchTotals` with the same ordering, I/O-exception handling and partial-count accumulation, which drops `GatherLcov` well under 15, and the `CHA0004` pragma stays scoped around the catch in the new helper. I judged this from the diff alone: I did not build it, and I assumed `rows` is declared as `Dictionary<string, FileCoverage>`, which the diff doesn't show.
